: One of my best mind games feats back when I was 15:

Me and my friends back in my highschool days, just before I graduated, wanted to do some fun activities before it ends. All of us are fans of the Russian series called "secrets of investigation" which has 23 seasons. So we wanted to play the "detectives against the criminals'' between 2 school grades (as we have been pretty popular and not only did it seem like a cool activity, majority follows things like sheep's, so, almost 2 whole grades, which is ~200 students will play this game. Majority already were also familiar or even fans of the Secrets of Investigation, so almost everyone knew a thing or two about crimes, laws and works of the detectives) In this game, you have 10 criminals and 10 detectives. Others will be playing like either victims of crimes, or regular passerbies or even as witnesses. What was interesting, is that you can't attack the detectives unless there's multiple criminals on 1 detective and there's no witnesses nearby. So usually the detectives worked together. All detectives know each other and all criminals know each other. Each game lasted 3 days straight, starting from 5 PM and ending at 5 PM 3 days later.
Rules and Conditions:

Limited Resources - Both detectives and criminals operate with constraints on time, manpower, and information, which was made to get more fun to the game, as you had to build the resources yourself mostly aside from something that each team possessed.
Mind Games - Psychological manipulation and planting false clues are crucial components, allowing both sides to outwit and confuse each other. And that's what was the main topic of this.
Area of Operation - The entire school and its yard serve as the playground for the cat-and-mouse game, to provide opportunities and challenges for both detectives and criminals.
Detective Restrictions - Limited surveillance time (2 hours per day).
Detectives must solve cases within three days for impactful crimes.
Each detective has only three attempts to incarcerate someone.
Criminal Restrictions - Cannot kill a detective in the presence of witnesses.
Must commit a major crime within three days to avoid losing.
Should leave clues to make the investigation challenging.
Merits: Detectives - Support from regular people.
Access to resources like cameras.
Criminals - Easier to blend into a crowd.
Possibility to eliminate detectives under specific conditions.
Negotiation:

Both sides can negotiate information exchange, either concealing or revealing their identities. Information should include details about their own side with the other party doing the same. If the criminal is hiding their identity while doing so, they can discard the information due to it. But if the criminal exposes their identity the detective has to listen and believe them about anything but them being a criminal, that's a solid fact. It's a double edged sword.
Special Skills:
Detectives - Interrogation.
Interrogation: Allows them to extract valuable information from witnesses, suspects, or caught criminals. Of course they have to see the truth for themselves.
Criminals - Kidnapping.
Kidnapping: Gain resources through open or hidden kidnappings, creating dilemmas for detectives, which they have to solve. Of course they have to still make preparations for it and execute it well.

Competition: The majority of the people there has seen a lot of Secrets of Investigation Series so they know some things about it too. Even the regular people know about there being criminals too, making them more careful but they can't be too careful to give breathing space to the criminals who are supposed to be hidden. Majority of the people were pretty smart and some were even gifted or almost genius levels, although there was only a few of such. I was lucky enough to play 2 games as Detective and 1 as a criminal. I was a criminal in the 2nd game, and Detective in 6th and 9th.

The series that this was based on, is a Russian series that has 23 seasons. There were over 100 solved cases here. And 1 Season = 1 year of their life. The main character is the woman you see in the middle, Maria. She is extremely talented and well known. The series name is "Secrets of Investigation”
